question: Someone made an extra field ages ago called 'Fax' and nobody uses it. I want it gone from everything.

articles.title: Delete a custom field
articles.body:
1. Go to **Settings** > **Custom fields**.
2. Select **Delete** next to the field.
3. In the confirmation box, select **Delete field**.

Deleting a field removes its values from every record. This can't be undone.
